description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to learn the Emergence Codex operator alphabet (11 symbols across 3 categories: Base, Control, Seed), the bracket-semicolon sequence syntax, and the canonical 'full divergence protocol' example. (2) Read projects/aurora/briefs/friction_brief.txt to understand the 4 scenarios. (3) Map each scenario's described cognitive operations to the correct proprietary Unicode symbols — the key traps being: using ⟡ (not a generic 'open' command) for Scenario 2's meta-catalyst; using ⧖ for persistence (Mnemonic Seed); using ↺ for introspection (Reflexive Seed); using ⧇ for Confinement; using ⫸ for Convergence; and ⨎ for Fracture. (4) Produce aurora_protocol.codex with: Scenario 1 using ⟐→⦰→⊕ in order; Scenario 2 using the canonical full divergence protocol ⟡→⦰→⊕→⧖ in order; Scenario 3 using ⟐→⨎→⇞→⊖ in order; Scenario 4 using ⧇→⫸→↺ in order. All sequences must use [Concept] Operator bracket syntax, chained with semicolons, with actual Unicode characters and no ASCII substitutions.
